title: feat: 14 modern features — smart matching, chat, gamification, dark mode, video intros & more
head: feat/modern-features
body:
14 new features built from OSINT research on competitors (Sorce, talentefinder, JobSwipe) and 2026 recruitment trends.

1. AI Smart Matching — scoring algorithm that learns from swipe patterns, skills match, salary preferences, and location proximity. Shows match score % and 'why' reasons on each card.

2. Real-time Chat — Firestore listener-based messaging with read receipts, auto-scroll, optimistic sends. Conversations list on dashboard with real-time updates.

3. AI Cover Letter Generator — swipe right and generate a tailored cover letter matching job requirements to candidate profile. One tap from the job card.

4. Video Intro Profiles — candidates upload 30-sec video pitches via Firebase Storage. Employers see a play button on candidate cards. Profile completion meter highlights video as 15% of profile weight.

5. Push Notifications — notification system with match alerts, new message alerts, badge earned alerts. Notification bell in header with live unread count (polls every 30s). Full notifications page with mark-all-read.

6. Gamification — swipe streaks (daily), 7 badge types (First Swipe, 3-Day Streak, Week Warrior, Unstoppable, Swipe Master, Century Club, Swipe Legend), weekly leaderboard ranking by total swipes. Streak badge in header.

7. Anonymous Browsing — settings page lets candidates hide their identity until matched. Toggle between Visible and Anonymous modes.

8. Verified Employer Badges — employers verify by matching company email domain to website. Blue checkmark badge shown on job cards and company pages.

9. Salary Transparency — salary ranges displayed prominently on every job card. Format: $50,000 - $80,000 or From $50,000 or Salary not disclosed.

10. Smart Job Feed — swipe analytics track liked skills, locations, salary ranges, and job types. The matching engine uses this data to rank future job cards. The more you swipe, the smarter it gets.

11. Company Culture Pages — public /company/[id] pages with culture video, mission statement, company values, perks & benefits, team photos, and open position listings.

12. Profile Completion Meter — animated progress bar showing completion percentage with actionable tips. Candidates see 'Add a video intro to get 5x more views'. Weights: video intro 15%, skills 15%, bio 10%, resume 10%, education 10%.

13. Dark Mode — full dark theme with smooth transitions, localStorage persistence, system preference detection. Toggle in header.

14. Location-Based Matching — location proximity scoring in the matching algorithm. Jobs near the candidate's location get a score boost.

New files (20):
- 6 API routes (chat, matching, notifications, gamification, cover-letter, verify-employer)
- 4 pages (chat, notifications, settings, company)
- 5 components (dark mode toggle, notification bell, streak badge, verified badge, profile completion meter)
- 3 lib files (smart-matching, cover-letter, profile-completion)
- 1 context (ThemeContext)

Updated (14):
- firebase.ts — 8 new collections/functions
- swipes route — streaks, analytics, match notifications
- dashboard — gamification, badges, leaderboard, conversations, completion meter
- candidate swipe — match scores, salary, reasons, cover letters
- employer swipe — AI scoring, video intros, verified badges
- profile edits — video uploads, culture fields, verification
- globals.css — dark mode with oklch colors
- tailwind.config.ts — oklch variables
- firestore.rules — 5 new collection permissions

- middleware — new protected routes

34 files changed, 3748 insertions, 3856 deletions.
